class.name: SpatialInventoryContainers
class.brief_description: Tracks which inventory grid owns each placed item and nested container.
class.description: Associate container items with their contents grids to enforce unique item IDs and prevent a container from moving into its own contents or descendants.

members.member: Optional game rule called with the placement context after the container ownership checks pass. Return an empty String to allow the placement or a reason to deny it. The default empty callable adds no game-specific restriction.
